review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked the main candidate for duplication, the upper-triangular group on GL. `upperTriangularGroup` is defined in the TauCeti repo (`TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/UpperTriangular/Basic.lean`) and has no counterpart in Mathlib. `isUpperTriangular_transvection_iff` is also a TauCeti declaration and has no Mathlib counterpart. The file's own constructions reuse existing infrastructure: `CommHopfAlgCat.quotientSpec`, `quotientSpecMapOfLe`, `liftQuotient`, `GeneralLinear.IntegralPointsPresentation`, and Mathlib's `Matrix.IsUpperTriangular` and `BlockTriangular`. `upperTriangularPointsPresentation` is a thin instance of the shared presentation API rather than a parallel one. The private `rootCoordinateMap` abbreviation only shortens a repeated call to `kostantRootSubgroupCoordinateMap`. I found no independent competing definition of a concept already in Mathlib, Batteries or core. I did not search for duplicates elsewhere in the TauCeti repo.
